## The question

> Which combine measurements and player position predict draft round among drafted players?

The intended audience is players who are looking to improve their draft round by improving their stats in the NFL Combine. This matters as a higher draft pick means more money for the players and potentially more playing time.

We use NFL Draft Combine data from the [SCORE Sports Data Repository](https://data.scorenetwork.org/football/nfl-draft-combine.html). The observational unit is one player at the NFL Combine (6,128 observations). The response is draft round, and the predictors are position (categorical), 40-yard dash (seconds), vertical jump (inches), bench press reps of 225 lbs, broad jump (inches), three-cone drill (seconds), and 20-yard shuttle (seconds). One important limitation is missing data: many players are missing at least one measurement, and players with missing measurements are excluded from complete-case models.
